'''Theodorus Jozef Dekker''' ('''Dirk Dekker''', 1 March 1927 - 25 November 2021)<ref>{{Cite web|title=In memoriam Dirk Dekker (1927-2021)|url=https://www.uva.nl/en/shared-content/subsites/informatics-institute/en/news/2021/12/in-memoriam-dirk-dekker.html|accessdate=|work=University of Amsterdam|date=2 December 2021}}</ref> was a Dutch [[mathematician]].

Dekker completed his [[Ph.D.]] degree from the [[University of Amsterdam]] in 1958. His thesis was titled "Paradoxical Decompositions of Sets and Spaces".

Dekker invented an algorithm that allows two processes to share a single-use resource without conflict, using only [[Shared memory (interprocess communication)|shared memory]] for communication, named [[Dekker's algorithm]].
